message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to pull in real‑time data from the internet.  
To find out the current air quality in Los Angeles you can check one of the following:

| Source | How to use |
|--------|------------|
| **EPA AirNow** (airnow.gov) | Enter “Los Angeles” or your ZIP code; it shows the latest AQI, pollutant levels, and health recommendations. |
| **AirVisual/AQI Forecast** (waqi.info) | Search for “Los Angeles”; it provides a live AQI map and historical trends. |
| **Weather.com / AccuWeather** | Look up “Los Angeles” → “Air Quality” tab. |
| **Mobile apps** – e.g., *AQICN*, *Plume Labs: Air Report* – give real‑time readings and alerts. |

If you’re looking for a quick snapshot, most of those sites update every 10–15 minutes. If you need the data programmatically, the EPA offers an API (https://www.airnow.gov/aqi/aqi-api/) that returns JSON with the latest measurements.
message.reasoning: User asks about current air quality in LA. We need real-time data. We don't have direct API. We can approximate using known sources like AQI from EPA or other. But we can't fetch live data. We could provide general info and suggest checking websites. But maybe we can use an external API? Not allowed. So answer with explanation that I cannot fetch real-time data. Provide guidance on how to check.
